provenance: Every source_excerpt is a literal line in the actual raw returned result at its file/record locator; original.question is newly revised; original_question remains null. Retrieval author tags are preserved.

A secondary transport defect requires distinguishing coboundary from differential
Noncommuting shears have an exact loop commutator
A return-map jet at multiplier minus one has a computable second iterate
A finite transfer operator has a genuine pressure and an implicit root derivative
A two-term coboundary complex has exact kernels and ranges in a finite Markov example
A triangular map admits an exact spectral-submanifold graph
A spectral gap alone does not select the smoothest invariant graph
A cyclic difference design has one exact gauge mode
Family-constant targets vanish under a symmetric difference design
Nested supports do not by themselves force a low-rank sensitivity matrix
Participation ratio quantifies spectral concentration without replacing rank
Temporal spectral color needs a specified stationary or integrated process
A determinant measures volume but does not determine a directional product field
Spherical product moments explain 105 and 945 Gaussian pairings
Trace-range realization is explicit for cyclic and dyadic groups
Gap-projection invariants factor through K₀ under an actual spectral gap
Morita trace scaling is an arithmetic lattice identity after normalization
AUROC is an exact pairwise statistic with a specified tie convention
Pooling standardized domains can create a correlation absent from each domain
Weighted projection is unique on a convex set but can have several competing branches
A nested fit improves training R²; a residual runs test asks a different question
A quadratic compatibility surface has a conditional minimum with a declared objective
A zeta spiral is a sampling layout with a conjugation symmetry
Path differences lie in a circulation kernel, with a useful converse on a finite DAG

source_gaps: The original K3,3 density, all residue observables and source vectors were not recovered. Declared exact Gaussian models replace unsupported reproduction of reported norms and Gram rank.
The original twelve-coordinate Jacobian, row weights and context targets were not recovered. The cyclic-difference model is explicitly newly declared.
Full transfer branches and a validated pressure operator were not recovered, so the reported root near0.8802487 and numerical defect values are not certified.

The general Hilbert-space SSM/NHIM theorem, compact invariant chart, graph transform estimates and nonlinear small-divisor bounds were not recovered; exact finite models show both existence and a resonance obstruction.

The final sweep contains named speculative correspondences, BRST/D4/Khovanov/Hecke lists, global SRB claims and a0.384 invariant in file summaries without sufficient definitions/proofs. No historical theorem is invented from those labels.

Original data for fit statistics, nesting/effective rank, cross-domain tests and intervention trajectories were not recovered. Mathematical estimators and counterexamples are developed without claiming successful empirical validation.
excluded_nonmathematics: Business-model and financial-advice discussion without a separately specified mathematical question.
historical_completeness: Comprehensive for distinct meaningful recovered mathematical clusters. Retrieval is not a complete chat export; an unrecovered passage is not evidence that no mathematics existed.
verification_scope: Portable standard-library scripts check exact rational identities, finite ranks, combinatorial counts and selected numerical examples. They do not turn approximations into interval-certified global theorems.
references: Relevant primary papers, author notes, official DLMF and author textbooks checked by web retrieval; unrelated default references removed. Elementary complete proofs may have an empty external reference list.
